test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select a suitable title for the given passage.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Central Theme:** The passage primarily focuses on** Sheena's determination to become a doctor despite the financial hardships faced by her family, highlighting the theme of pursuing dreams against significant odds.** 
 
• **Sheena's Efforts:** The narrative describes **Sheena's **efforts to work after school and save money for her education, demonstrating her commitment to her goal.
 
• **Family's Sacrifice:** The story also mentions her father's sacrifice of selling ancestral property to support her dream, **which underscores the collective effort to overcome obstacles.**
 
• **Achievement: **Despite the challenges,** Sheena's success in securing a high rank in the medical entrance test and getting admission to a government medical college exemplifies the realization of dreams against difficult circumstances.**
 
• **Inspirational Element: **The passage serves as an inspiring example of how determination and hard work can lead to success, which is encapsulated by the title** 'Pursuing Dreams Against Odds'.**
 
• **Overcoming Hardships:** The title captures the essence of overcoming financial and personal hardships **to achieve one's aspirations, **a central message conveyed in the passage.

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: Unexpected Opportunities - **This is incorrect because the passage focuses more on Sheena's proactive efforts and sacrifices rather than any unexpected opportunities.
 
• **Option 3: Financial Struggles -** This is incorrect as it only captures part of the story, focusing on struggles rather than the broader theme of pursuing dreams despite those struggles.
 
• **Option 4: Small Town Struggles -** This is incorrect as it limits the scope of the passage to the struggles of living in a small town, while the passage is more about pursuing a dream against all odds.
